start.titleOnboarding: Let us prepare your first transaction.
start.titleCase: Let us structure your next transaction.
start.body: You explain the objective. Offroad organizes the request, builds the right information list and shows what is missing at every step.
start.guidedTitle: Start with what the company needs to accomplish
start.guidedBody: You do not need to know the market structure or assemble a data room before you begin. We will ask the right questions in the right order.
start.stepOperationBody: Tell us what the capital needs to enable.
start.stepRequestBody: Amount, timing and essential context, without jargon.
start.stepDocumentsBody: See the minimum, recommended and ideal set for your case.
start.documentsBody: Upload what you already have. Offroad identifies, organizes and pre-fills the registration with field-level evidence.
start.manualBody: Enter information step by step and add documents later. Best when materials are still being collected.
start.security: Private documents, organization-restricted access and mandatory confirmation before submission.
start.howTitleMuted: Offroad prepares the path to market.
start.howIntro: First, we want to understand the company: what it does, its sector and markets, its strengths and what sets it apart. Then, the project it intends to finance and the use of proceeds. In a few lines, in your own words. If an institutional presentation already exists, simply attach it.
start.howAnalysis: Share whatever is available: business plan, financial statements, contracts, accounting records or corporate documents. PDF, Excel or photo, exactly as they are. Offroad reads everything, organizes it, cross-checks one document against another and flags what does not reconcile, so it can be clarified before reaching investors.
start.howMarket: From there, we propose structures aligned with the transaction and prepare a complete information package, including a teaser, financial projections and an indicative term sheet, in the format the market expects. We understand financing products and maintain relationships with a broad base of capital providers. We know what each one reviews, how they review it and what they require for approval. This direction increases the transaction's probability of success. The introduction is conducted through the platform, with your authorization and only to investors whose mandates are aligned.
start.youDo1Body: What it does, its sector and markets, its strengths and differentiators. If you already have an institutional presentation, simply attach it.
start.youDo2Body: What you intend to finance and the amount you have in mind. In your own words, without a form.
start.youDo3Body: Financial statements, contracts and corporate documents. Drag and drop, in any format.
start.youDo4Body: An intuitive chat with our specialized AI, focused only on what the documents did not answer.
start.offroadDoes1Body: We read each document to understand how the company operates, its financial dynamics and the transaction it intends to pursue.
start.offroadDoes2Body: We reconcile sources so every piece of information has documentary support. If something is unclear, we ask.
start.offroadDoes3Body: We understand the products and what each capital provider reviews, how they review it and in what format.
start.offroadDoes4Body: We present structures aligned with the transaction, including their respective advantages, trade-offs and indicative costs.
start.offroadDoes5Body: Teaser, financial projections and indicative term sheet, in the standard and format the market expects.
start.offroadDoes6Title: Connects the transaction to the market precisely
start.offroadDoes6Body: Only to investors whose mandates fit the transaction, with your authorization.

case.materialTruthBody: The teaser, memorandum, indicative term sheet, Q&A, model and room are compiled from the same governed basis and measured by all 32 material procedures.
case.empty: No analysis yet: process the documents first.
case.modelWhat: A spreadsheet with live formulas: operating projection, debt schedule, DSCR and leverage against the playbook's ceiling. Every editable cell is on the Assumptions sheet, so change one and the whole model recalculates. Every historical number is traced to its source document.
case.modelBlocked: The model needs at least one reconciled number. Upload the financial statements and it becomes available.
case.briefInProgress: The written case is being prepared right now. The numbers, exceptions and structure below are ready; refresh in a moment to read the text.
case.marketTruthBody: The transaction is screened against dated mandates using objective filters. The shortlist has an explicit rationale, never a magic percentage. The product ends at an authorised introduction to the right people.
case.marketReadyBody: Recipients, contacts, rationale and materials are tied to the versions authorised by the company.
case.marketPendingTitle: Investor contact is not authorised yet
case.marketPendingBody: The analysis may indicate alignment, but nobody receives materials before a current mandate, consistent package, named-recipient plan and company authorisation are all in place.
case.financialTruthBody: Reconciled statements, explicit adjustments, cash conversion and accounting identities. No gap becomes a silent estimate.
case.financialTruthEmpty: There is no structured financial statement yet.
case.debtTruthBody: Each instrument, obligation, security and covenant remains separate and traceable to its source.
case.debtTruthEmpty: There are not enough instruments to build the ledger yet.
case.operationTruthBody: The request is compared with calculated need. Sources, uses, working capital, costs, draws and the pro forma position remain tied and traceable.
case.structureTruthBody: Amount, tenor, repayment, security and covenants are tested against capacity, downside, existing obligations and day-one compatibility. Offroad proposes the structure without committing capital or replacing lender diligence.
case.pricingTruthBody: A range is only published when comparable, current, authorized and traceable observations meet house policy. The reference is indicative and does not represent a firm offer, capital commitment, credit decision or replacement for lender diligence.
case.pricingAbstentionTitle: No reliable reference for this cell
case.pricingAbstentionBody: The available sample does not yet meet comparability, freshness, independence and dispersion criteria. No range was estimated or filled by approximation.

brief.title: Share only the essentials for now
brief.body: Amount, timing and basic context are enough to personalize the next step. Answer what you know and leave the rest for later.
brief.objectiveLabel: What the company intends to accomplish
brief.objectiveHint: Describe the plan in plain language. You do not need to know the financing structure.
brief.objectivePlaceholder: Open three stores, expand the plant, refinance maturities or complete an acquisition.
brief.advancedTitle: Already know more about security, cost or instrument?
brief.advancedBody: Optional. Open this only if those preferences are already defined. Offroad can recommend the structure after the analysis.
brief.amountLabel: How much the company needs to raise
brief.amountHint: Write it however you like: 45,000,000 or 45 million.
brief.urgencyLabel: When the capital needs to be available
brief.urgencyHint: An approximate timeframe is enough to organize the process.
brief.termHint: How long the company needs to repay.
brief.graceHint: How long before amortisation starts. Optional.
brief.consequenceHint: Explain what the company gains by executing the plan and what changes if it is delayed.
brief.consequencePlaceholder: The investment adds capacity before the next commercial cycle and protects contracts already identified.
brief.sectorHint: In a word or two, how the company would describe itself.
brief.geographyHint: The two-letter state code. BR if national.
brief.collateralHint: Tick what exists today. Security rarely decides who lends on its own, but it moves price and structure a great deal.
brief.collateralNote_recebiveis: trade receivables, card, payer contracts, work billed
brief.collateralNote_imovel: owned by the company, the shareholders or the holding
brief.collateralNote_estoque: goods that turn, with proper control
brief.collateralNote_aval_fianca: personal guarantee, asked for almost always
brief.collateralNote_cessao_fiduciaria: collections land in an account that secures the debt
brief.collateralNote_conta_reserva: cash locked up, worth a few instalments
brief.instrumentLabel: Instrument, only if you already have a preference
brief.instrumentHint: If you do not know, leave it blank: that part is ours. And blank is better early, because in Brazil the instrument decides which vehicles may hold the paper, and ticking one now removes funds that would have said yes.
brief.instrumentNote_debenture: for a corporation; reaches funds and investors
brief.instrumentNote_nota_comercial: simpler than a debênture, for corporations and limitadas
brief.instrumentNote_ccb: bank credit note; the most direct route
brief.instrumentNote_cri: when the credit has real-estate backing
brief.instrumentNote_cra: when the credit has agribusiness backing
brief.instrumentNote_direct_loan: a bilateral contract with the lender
brief.instrumentNote_project_finance: the project repays and answers for the debt
brief.rateHint: However you think about it: 13% a year, CDI + 4, 1.2% a month. If you have no idea, leave it blank. The lender sets the price, and our read on what the market has been paying for this profile comes back to you after the analysis.

desk.title: Credit desk
desk.assumptions: CDI at {cdi}, reference date {date}. Arithmetic over reconciled facts; the narrative may rephrase these numbers, it may not renumber them.
desk.trajectoryAssumptions: Stressed case: projected growth cut by {haircut}, audited base preserved. Proposed covenant sits {cushion} above the stressed case.
desk.lmBody: The transaction takes out {lenders} ({balance}), the only covenanted lines, leaving {newMoney} of new money. Leverage after the swap: {leverage}.
desk.questionsBody: In meeting order. Each question comes from a reading above; none is generic.
desk.missingSomeTitle: What is still missing to close the analysis
desk.missingSomeBody: The desk ran with what there was. These fields would sharpen the reading.
desk.missingAllBody: The fields below are missing. Send the document that carries each one and the analysis is assembled automatically.
desk.lmBodyRefinancing: The raise repays {balance} of existing debt at disbursement (a liability swap), leaving {newMoney} of new money. Leverage after the swap: {leverage}.

deliveryMap.fileUnmatched: read as {kind}; covers no item on the list
deliveryMap.fileWaiting: waiting to be read; click Analyse documents
deliveryMap.fileUnrecognised: read but not recognised; say what it is by answering the matching item
deliveryMap.empty: No files yet. Drop them above and each item ticks itself when the right document arrives.

committee.title: Committee
committee.stressTitle: Sensitivity: standard shocks on the post-transaction position
committee.priceTitle: Indicative price (internal; the term sheet carries no rate)

Sounding.title: Sounding and book
Sounding.intro: The list, what each investor did, and the indications on one ruler. Nothing leaves without an NDA, and the book is arithmetic over what was indicated.
Sounding.error_transition: The process does not allow this event at this stage (no room before the NDA; no allocation without an indication).
Sounding.openHint: Set the target and the reading basis. Every indication is read against this CDI.
Sounding.listEmpty: No investor on the list yet. Add from the shortlist below.
Sounding.subject: subject to committee
